articles.summary: TERRE HAUTE, Ind., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First Financial Corporation (NASDAQ:THFF) today announced results for the third quarter of 2026. Net income was $27.4 million compared to $20.8 million reported for the same period of 2025; Diluted net income per common share of $2.31 compared to $1.75 for the same period of 2025; Return on average assets was 1.79% compared to 1.48% for the three months ended September 30, 2025; Benefit from credit losses was $750 thousand compared to provision expense of $2.0 million for the third quarter 2025; and Pre-tax, pre-provision net income was $33.7 million compared to $27.7 million for the same period in 2025. 1 The Corporation further reported results for the nine months ended September 30, 2026: Net income was $70.0 million compared to $57.8 million reported for the same period of 2025; Diluted net income per common share of $5.89 compared to $4.87 for the same period of 2025; Return on average assets was 1.54% compared to
articles.title: First Financial Corporation Reports Third Quarter Results
